LanguageData.ARIO_StallPerishableDesc: This food can spoil. Refrigeration slows spoilage, while freezing can stop it.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallTakeOutDesc: Choose how many goods to return to ordinary storage. Colonists must haul them from the stall; they stay here until a hauler has a clear route and somewhere suitable to put them.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallTakeOutQueued: {0} items queued for colonist hauling back to storage. They will wait for suitable storage and an available hauler.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallTakeOutUnavailable: These goods are no longer available to take out.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallOutgoingTip: Colonists will return these goods to suitable storage when space, a route and a hauler are available. Cancelling stops goods that have not been picked up; a hauler already carrying something can finish the trip.
